document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Your  hesitation  is  wise.  The  figure  is  Charlie  Foxtail,  your 
missing guide. But something holds you back from celebration. 
She returns your stare with an emptiness that chills your blood. 
Yet you sense confusion, not malice, in the woman.

You speak in soft, reassuring tones. Make a Hard POW roll, but 
with a bonus die: if you succeed, go to 208; if you fail, go to 127.
